misconceptions.description: Failing to separate load that comes from the content itself (intrinsic) from load the design adds (extraneous)
misconceptions.trigger: learner labels a removable design flaw as inherent difficulty, or calls inherent difficulty a design flaw
misconceptions.feedback: Ask whether the load comes from the material or from the presentation. Extraneous load is removable; intrinsic load is staged, not deleted.

misconceptions.description: Assuming every form of mental effort should be minimized, including the germane load that produces learning
misconceptions.trigger: learner proposes cutting practice or elaboration to reduce load
misconceptions.feedback: Distinguish germane load, the productive effort of building schemas, from extraneous load. Reduce the wasteful kind, protect the productive kind.

misconceptions.description: Accepting an undifferentiated AI high or low load rating as a usable diagnosis
misconceptions.trigger: learner adopts AI load labels without naming a load type or the screen evidence behind it
misconceptions.feedback: A diagnosis names the load type and the screen feature causing it. Use AI ratings only as prompts to inspect, then evidence each one.
